name: Handoffkit
description:
Push AI session handoffs to HandoffKit automatically via MCP. 
Store your AI prompts, handoff messages, and session context in one place. 
Checkbox-select what each session needs and copy with one click. 
This plugin connects Claude Code projects to HandoffKit for seamless session continuity across projects.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install handoffkit@claude-community` from `Norsninja/handoffkit-plugin`.

Push AI session handoffs directly to HandoffKit from Claude Code. No more copy-pasting between your terminal and the browser.

Push AI session handoffs to HandoffKit automatically via MCP. 
Store your AI prompts, handoff messages, and session context in one place. 
Checkbox-select what each session needs and copy with one click. 
This plugin connects Claude Code projects to HandoffKit for seamless session continuity across projects.
